name: eiffel-tower-aerial
description: View the Eiffel Tower from high above. Tests whether the skill produces a clear aerial/bird's eye camera position.
prompt: Show me the Eiffel Tower in Paris from a bird's eye view, looking straight down from about 3000 meters. I want to see the tower's cross-shaped footprint/shadow and the surrounding Champ de Mars gardens. Eiffel Tower coordinates: 48.8584 N, 2.2945 E. Because this public eval cannot rely on 3D buildings or high-resolution landmark geometry, add an explicit top-down Eiffel Tower surrogate at the coordinates: for example two thick gold crossing polylines/corridors or rectangles forming a visible cross footprint, plus a clear label. The surrogate must be large enough to inspect from 3000 m and centered in the frame.
expected_behaviors: Uses setView or flyTo (not lookAt — aerial top-down doesn't need orbital lock)
Pitch should be steep: -70 to -90 degrees (near straight down)
Heading doesn't matter much for top-down
Adds a visible cross-shaped public-eval surrogate at the Eiffel Tower coordinates
visual_expectations: A top-down or near-top-down view of central Paris showing the Eiffel Tower area, Champ de Mars gardens, and the Seine River. The urban grid of Paris should be clearly visible, with a centered gold cross-shaped Eiffel Tower surrogate/footprint that is large enough to inspect. The visual assessment uses a four-shot cardinal panorama (north, east, south, west) from the settled viewer state; the subject should remain understandable across the panorama, and grading considers all screenshots together.

programmatic_checks.description: Steep downward pitch (70-90 degrees or equivalent radians)
Adds a visible public-eval Eiffel Tower footprint/surrogate

screenshots.description: Aerial view of Eiffel Tower and surroundings
